meaning.story: This song explores a high-stakes, mutual obsession between two people who are drawn to each other’s dangerous allure despite knowing the consequences. The subtext reveals a toxic intimacy where both parties are complicit in their own destruction, symbolized by neon teeth representing the addictive, destructive pull of their connection.

sections.name: Intro
sections.interpretation: Sets the stage for a nocturnal, high-intensity encounter with ultraviolet glow and magnetic tension

sections.name: Verse 1
sections.interpretation: The narrator acknowledges their attraction to the other person’s physical presence and magnetic pull, despite the risk of being destroyed
sections.keyLine: Already hers before the end of the night

sections.name: Chorus
sections.interpretation: The mutual pull between the two characters is described as both alluring and destructive, with neon teeth symbolizing the inevitable damage
sections.keyLine: Just to feel the bite of those neon teeth

sections.name: Bridge
sections.interpretation: Highlights the aftermath of the relationship, where both have left but the emotional damage remains
sections.keyLine: Just the taste of the words that we never said

sections.name: Verse 2
sections.interpretation: The narrator reflects on the other person’s power over them, with the relationship being both intoxicating and destructive
sections.keyLine: I swear I’m in control while she pulls me beneath her

keyLines: You shine like trouble lighting up the dark
One crooked smile and you’re pulling me apart
Sweet little poison sitting on your lips
Just to feel the bite of those neon teeth
